quotations.old_english: Ic hine þe befæste mid heálicre gecneordnisse on Crístes gewitnysse
quotations.english: I most earnestly commend him to you calling Christ to witness

quotations.old_english: Nánes fracodes gecneor(d)nysse ne gewilnion hí

source_text: ge-cneordnes; (1) add :-- Ic hine þe befæste mid heálicre gecneordnisse on Crístes gewitnysse I most earnestly commend him to you calling Christ to witness, Ælfc. T. Grn. 16, 47. (2) add :-- Nánes fracodes gecneor(d)nysse ne gewilnion hí nequaquam fraudis cuiusque studium appetant, Chrd. 76, 33.
